lines.zh: 我成群游过珊瑚的缝隙。
lines.en: I school through the gaps in the coral.

lines.zh: 眼下的光把前面的水照亮。
lines.en: The light under my eye lights the way.
I skim the sand, fins never still.

lines.zh: 十几条同伴跟着我拐弯。
lines.en: A dozen of my school turns with me.

lines.zh: 我游进深水珊瑚的阴影。
lines.en: I swim into deep-coral shadow.

lines.zh: 暖海的水很清，我看得远。
lines.en: The warm sea is clear; I see far.
One flick of my tail moves the school.
I round the reef looking for dark.

lines.zh: 光在水里划出细细一条。
lines.en: My light draws a thin line in the water.
I slip through a crack in the rock.

lines.zh: 我们一群贴着海草边缘走。
lines.en: We hug the edge of the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我向下游，水压慢慢加重。
lines.en: I swim down and the pressure grows.

lines.zh: 前面有条大鱼，我换了个方向。
lines.en: A big fish ahead; I change course.

lines.zh: 我游得很急，尾巴拍着水。
lines.en: I swim fast, tail beating the water.

lines.zh: 我把发光器亮了一下，同伴跟来。
lines.en: I flash my light once, and my school follows.

lines.zh: 水草擦过我的侧腹，有点痒。
lines.en: The seagrass brushes my flank. It tickles.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚枝绕了半圈。
lines.en: I sweep half a circle along the coral branches.

lines.zh: 前面有条影子，我沉下去。
lines.en: There's a shadow ahead. I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我游得整齐，和同伴隔开一格。
lines.en: I swim in line, a body-length from my neighbor.

lines.zh: 沙地上有光斑，是我照出来的。
lines.en: Those bright spots on the sand are mine.

lines.zh: 我悬在礁石边，光一明一暗。
lines.en: I hover by the reef, light pulsing.
My school surrounds me, all still.
I shrink my light to a single point.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，看水里的浮尘。
lines.en: Tilted, I watch motes in the water.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼游近了，我让开。
lines.en: A small fish nears; I move aside.
I fan my fins slowly and hold place.
A warm current comes off the coral.

lines.zh: 我们都朝着同一个方向。
lines.en: We all face the same way.

lines.zh: 我眼下的光映在礁面上。
lines.en: My light reflects on the reef face.

lines.zh: 我等着天黑，好出来找食。
lines.en: I wait for dark to come out and feed.

lines.zh: 一条同伴碰了碰我的鳍。
lines.en: A schoolmate nudges my fin.
Bubbles rise in strings.

lines.zh: 我缩进珊瑚枝里歇一会儿。
lines.en: I tuck into the coral to rest.
I keep still, light turned down.

lines.zh: 你游过来，我的光晃了一下。
lines.en: You swim near; my light wavers.
I watch you from behind the school.

lines.zh: 你的影子把光都挡住了。
lines.en: Your shadow swallows my light.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿绕了半圈。
lines.en: I make a half-turn around your legs.
Something in your hand is glowing.
I stare at your bright visor.

lines.zh: 同伴都躲了，我留下看你。
lines.en: The school hides; I stay and watch.
You move and the whole school scatters.
I hold still beside your hand.
My eye-light points straight at you.
A scale has been scraped off.
My light flares wildly out of control.
I sink beneath the reef to hide.
My schoolmates circle me.
That bite went deep.
I swim in rising and falling lines.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出的血把水染浑了。
lines.en: Blood from the cut clouds the water.
I hide in a coral crack, motionless.
A fin is torn; I swim slower.
My lamp still burns, only faint.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎食在水里飘。
lines.en: The crumbs you scatter drift down.
I smell it, and my tail moves first.
The whole school swims at your hand.
My light grows brighter.
I squeeze to the very front of the school.

lines.zh: 那点东西沉得慢，我等着。
lines.en: It sinks slowly; I wait under it.
I mouth it once and back away.
This smell drives the school wild.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，还是回来吃。
lines.en: I circle once, then come back to eat.

lines.zh: 你手一收，我追了一小段。
lines.en: You pull back; I chase a short way.
Your bump breaks up our school.

lines.zh: 我被挤到礁石上，鳞片响了。
lines.en: I am pressed to the reef, scales scraping.
A schoolmate hits me; I spin.

lines.zh: 水一乱，我的光晃得厉害。
lines.en: The water churns and my light shakes.
I crash into coral and get stuck.
Your knee knocks me far away.
Because of me the school knots up.
I shake my fins and steady myself.
You stir the sand into a cloud.
Do not shove; we school tightly.

lines.zh: 我被水流压得贴在石上。
lines.en: The current pins me against the stone.
A schoolmate's fin scrapes past me.
I swim beside her, light to light.
We loop around the coral head together.
Her glow holds steadier than mine does.
I brush her belly with a fin.
We swim abreast along the reef.
The school swirls around us.
She leads; I stay right with her.
We slip into the coral's dark.
Two little lights became one.
The water warms and we draw closer.
I take a coral chip in my mouth.
It is too heavy and drops out.
I carry an egg away in my mouth.
This thing glows; I want it.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进石缝里存着。
lines.en: I jam it into a rock crevice for safekeeping.
A schoolmate grabs at it; I swim off.
My mouth is stuffed full.
Holding it, my light dims.
It slips; I bite down again.

lines.zh: 我把捡的都堆在同一处。
lines.en: I pile my finds in one place.
A shrimp flicks about under the reef.
I see a scrap of meat sinking.
The school turns that way together.
That little fish has fallen behind.
I swim to the front of the school to look.
My light finds it and it holds still.

lines.zh: 它躲在珊瑚影里，我看见了。
lines.en: It hides in coral shadow; I see it.
There is enough here for the school.
I pick the nearest angle.
The taste in the water points one way.
The school closes in slowly.
I swim at its flank and behind.
It flees; we follow.

lines.zh: 我压低了身子，几乎贴沙。
lines.en: I drop until I almost touch sand.

lines.zh: 光收暗了，它看不见我们。
lines.en: Our lights dim; it cannot see us.
A schoolmate blocks the other side.
It turns twice; no way out.
I close another half body-length.

lines.zh: 整群安静得像一片影子。
lines.en: The school goes still as a shadow.
It blunders into our ring.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的尾鳍，死不松口。
lines.en: I lock onto its tail fin and hold.
The school rushes in together.
We crowd it until it tips over.
I take one bite and pull back.
The water blurs with motion.
It breaks free; I chase.

lines.zh: 小牙一排排，咬得它乱摆。
lines.en: Rows of small teeth make it thrash.
The school pins it against the reef.
It stops moving; we still circle.
I grab a scrap and swim off.

lines.zh: 我们从珊瑚礁里一起游出。
lines.en: We pour out of the coral together.
The light under my eye comes on first.
A big school, too many to count.
The sand of the warm shallows is white.
Under the deep coral it is dark.
I swim pressed among my schoolmates.
Plenty of reef to hide in here.
I flap my fins and follow the school.
The lights join into one field.
This is my first time out of the reef.

lines.zh: 水烫得像烧开了，我往下钻。
lines.en: The water boils; I dive down.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔得发晕。
lines.en: I am thrown out and land dazed.

lines.zh: 我在水里也会喘不上气。
lines.en: Even in water I can gasp.
The blast scatters the whole school.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我旁边的水。
lines.en: An arrow cuts the water beside me.

lines.zh: 一股怪力压着我的灯眼。
lines.en: A strange force presses on my light organ.

lines.zh: 碎食都没有，我饿得乱游。
lines.en: No crumbs at all; I swim in circles.

lines.zh: 电顺着水过来，我僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning runs through the water; I lock up.

lines.zh: 下面空空的，我拼命摆鳍。
lines.en: Nothing below; I beat my fins hard.
